description_en: Queries a list of OpenSearch applications
kebab_example: aliyun opensearch list-app-groups --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --instance-id ops-cn-xxxx --name my_name --type standard --sort-by 0 --resource-group-id 110123123 --tags value=bar key=foo --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAppGroups

parameters.description_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10.
parameters.description_zh: 每页返回数目，默认 pageSize=10
parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回数目，默认 pageSize=10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en: The ID of the instance. An exact match is performed.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. An exact match is performed
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The type of the application. Valid values:

- standard: a Standard Edition application.

- enhanced: a Premium Edition application.
parameters.description_zh:
应用类型

- standard 标准版
- enhanced 新高级版
parameters.help_en:
The type of the application. Valid values:

- standard: a Standard Edition application.

- enhanced: a Premium Edition application
parameters.help_zh:
应用类型

- standard 标准版
- enhanced 新高级版
parameters.name: type

parameters.description_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- 0: Sorts applications by creation time in descending order.

- 1: Sorts applications by modification time in descending order.

Default value: 0.
parameters.description_zh:
排列顺序

- 0：按创建时间降序排列
- 1：按修改时间降序排列

默认 sortBy=0
